summary: Held ArcRho Engine and Save Gateway to their configured instance caps when several users are signed into the server.
details: Each signed-in user's Orchestrator used to fill the same shortfall at the same time, so a five-worker cap produced eight or nine Engines.
Replenishment now waits for a launched component to publish its heartbeat instead of assuming a fixed startup time.
A component that fails during startup is retried on the next pass rather than launched without limit.
The Save Gateway now refuses to share its port, so a second copy exits instead of serving part of the traffic.
